title: Capture of Mahdia (1550)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Mahdia (1550)", at revision 1375739652, opens: "The capture of Mahdia was an amphibious military operation that took place from June to September, 1550, during the struggle between the Ottoman Empire and the Spanish Habsburgs for the control of the Mediterranean." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5037032, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1550 naval siege and land capture of Mahdia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
